verdict.rationale: impots.gouv.fr is a government tax-administration portal for filing, paying, and looking up tax information. Building, versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-defined automations is outside this kind of product. Its automatic CFE direct-debit option and its declaration-correction service are payment and filing features, not user automations, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
